guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is raising its full year 2026 financial guidance. The table below reflects our updated full year 2026 financial guidance.

Prior 2026 | Updated 2026 | Change (At Midpoint)
Core Sales Growth | 2.5% to 4.5% | 3.2% to 3.8% | No Change
Adjusted EBITDA | $800 to $830 Million | $809 to $823 Million | + $1 Million
Adjusted EPS | $1.62 to $1.70 | $1.66 to $1.72 | + $0.03
Capital Expenditures | ~$120 Million | ~$120 Million | No Change
Free Cash Flow Conversion | 90%+ | 90%+ | No Change
Share-based metrics in the Company’s guidance do not include the effect of any potential share repurchases.
